Mir Monuwar Iqbal (nickname Masum; born 10 May 1976) is a Bangladeshi IT entrepreneur and business executive. He is the founder and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Pridesys IT Limited and Pridesys Global LLC. He is recognized for his contributions to business digitalization, enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions, and ICT innovation in Bangladesh and internationally.
Early life
Mir Monuwar Iqbal was born on 10 May 1976 in Bangladesh. He spent his childhood in Gosinga Union, Sreepur Upazila, Gazipur District. His father, Mir Nure Abdul Hae, was the former Chairman of Gosinga Union, and his mother is Monuwara Begum.
Education
He earned a Bachelor of Science (BSc) degree in Computer Science from London Metropolitan University. Later, he completed a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from a reputed university in Bangladesh.
Career
Early career
After completing his education, Iqbal began his professional journey in the software industry. He worked in various national and international software companies in roles such as Software Engineer, System Analyst, and Chief Technology Officer (CTO).
Entrepreneurship
Iqbal founded Pridesys IT Limited to provide secure, scalable, and internationally compliant ERP solutions, aiming to empower young Bangladeshi engineers. Pridesys IT has developed ERP solutions for industries including ready-made garments (RMG), healthcare, education, telecommunications, trading businesses, and e-governance.
International presence
Under Iqbal’s leadership, Pridesys IT expanded its services to more than 10 countries including the USA, Thailand, Singapore, Japan, and other international markets.
Leadership and contributions
Iqbal recognized early the importance of digital transformation for Bangladesh’s RMG sector and promoted ERP adoption to enhance productivity, reduce errors, and ensure global competitiveness. He also integrated advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), big data analysis, blockchain, and the Internet of Things (IoT) into the company’s products.
Iqbal is actively involved in ICT policy-making in Bangladesh, mentoring IT projects, and creating employment opportunities for Bangladeshi engineers.
Awards and recognition
BASIS National ICT Award, Industry Application Category (2017)
Entrepreneur Award (Uddokta Award), Bangladesh Open-Source Network (BdOSN)
APICTA Merit Award (2019) for Pridecut, an AI-based fabric planning solution
The Daily Star ICT Awards, ICT Solution Provider of the Year (2021)
Personal life
Mir Monuwar Iqbal has two children, a son and a daughter.
Net worth
As of recent estimates, Mir Monuwar Iqbal's net worth is approximately US$87 million.
